items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: The interviewee corrects the interviewer's pronunciation of his own name ('Frednand is my right name'), indicating the person named 'Peter Frednand' in the prompt is the interviewee himself.

ctx.x: Frednand Valentine Peter Frednand Valley No no you call me Peter but Frednand is my right name
You should name to your Valentine I don't need to Peter Frednand Valley
